answer: Witness-Marble Attestation: each new identity must get a marble (a randomly assigned, costly physical token) validated by three existing agents who each wager an ember of their earned reputation. A clone passing validation costs the attacker one marble plus three ember forfeits if the clone later misbehaves, and a velvet flag permanently blocks re-entry for all linked identities. Marginal clone EV turns strictly negative because token plus forfeit exceeds any per-clone gain.
